summary: Verified disease database seeding fix on preview environment. Backend has 2568 diseases (exceeds 1977+ requirement). Find Condition panel and Disease Browser (Browse All) both load, filter by category, and search correctly. All acceptance criteria met.

minor.issue: Endpoint ignores query params (search, category, limit). Filtering is done client-side which is intentional but list returns full 2568 payload each call (~250KB). Consider adding server-side filter/pagination for perf.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: `DialogContent` missing `DialogTitle`/`Description` accessibility props (non-blocking a11y issue)

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogTitle/Description or VisuallyHidden wrapper to Find Condition dialog for a11y
(Optional) Add server-side search/pagination to /api/diseases-db/list to reduce payload size
critical_code_review_comments: /api/diseases-db/list returns entire 2568-disease payload on every call; frontend caches via 'Fetched fresh diseases: 2568' logs but the endpoint has no query filtering despite frontend potentially benefiting from it.
server.py is 12,666 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Splitting into routers/modules recommended.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Confirmed existing seed of 2568 diseases in preview DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview /api/diseases-db/list returns total=2568 and /api/diseases-db/stats confirms 2568 across 46 categories. Frontend Find Condition side panel shows '2498-2566 diseases' (filtered subset) and Browse All shows '2,568 diseases'. Both category expansion and search verified working (diabetes → matches; nonsense string → 'No diseases found').
rca of the issue: Original bug: production DB was empty of diseases (0 shown). Fix: POST /api/diseases-db/import-full loaded 1977 diseases from /app/backend/data/exported_diseases.json. Preview environment separately shows 2568 diseases (already seeded + additional entries). Verified end-to-end: DB → API → UI list/search/expand all functional.
